{{Top|leg}}
The expression '''''Moira-Just-Got-Off-A-Starliner''''' was used to describe tourists that visited the [[Corporate Sector/Legends|Corporate Sector]].

==History==
[[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]] used the term to refer to travelers less experienced with the average Corporate Sector world and the overwhelming of their individual senses by the constant and intrusive advertising found there. He also admitted to having experienced the same thing when first arriving.
